rationale: Repair the room-opening browser smoke's Python command selection and startup diagnostics on native Windows. Only the smoke and documentation change; room deletion, opening promotion, configuration and all product behaviour remain unchanged relative to v1.82.0.

summary.ru: Браузерная проверка удаления комнаты использует доступный Python на Windows и сразу сообщает об ошибке запуска backend oracle.
summary.en: The room deletion browser smoke uses an available Python on Windows and reports backend oracle startup failures directly.
